answer: The salt maker rakes his pans at dawn and heaps the salt in cones the overseer measures with a rod. Dental hygienist registration with dental council attestation is the overseer's rod: three-year training, 1,000 supervised clinical hours, board exam, annual renewal. A cone built from another man's violet melts in the first rain and leaves the thief with nothing. The nadir is the fine, two seasons of salt paid to the pan owner, and the walnut is the salt book, kept at the pans and read by the collector every quarter.
